name: Sliding Window Maximum
description: Finds the maximum in every sliding window of size k using a deque (monotonic decreasing queue). Achieves O(n) time.
aim: For each window position, find maximum in O(1) by maintaining a deque of indices in decreasing order of values.
howItWorks: Maintain a deque storing indices of useful elements
Front of deque always holds index of window maximum
Remove front if outside current window
Remove rear while rear element ≤ current element

time.averageCase: Each element added and removed from deque at most once

complexity.spaceDescription: Deque holds at most k indices

realWorld: Monitoring maximum temperature in rolling window
whenToUse: Maximum/minimum in all windows of size k
Any problem requiring monotonic queue pattern
alternatives: Segment tree — O(log n) per query, supports updates
Sparse table — O(n log n) build, O(1) static queries
